bench: G6 (H-S10) at the level of the sandbox agent's affordance memory: second-encounter error after one surprise, against plain replay and replay with priority
protocol: per trial: 12 blocks behaving the usual way for one kind of prediction, met twice each; one surprise block; then a never-met block sharing only the cause (second encounter) and a never-met control block on the usual side; noise: one bit makes a block go either way at random, a surprise on one, then six more such blocks
rule_kinds: harm, chill, breath (one bit present), pass, break (one bit absent), food (two bits together)

arms.postmortem: blame bits, exonerate from memory, lessons consulted before likeness

live.world: one sandbox world (the agent tests' golden seed)
